log.text: M15 barrier: a fresh demand zone 1.35824 to 1.35964, an engulf (EG) zone: the last down candle before a close above its high.
Price left the barrier and came back to it (visit 2). Its confirmation is read on M1. The barrier is AGAINST the H1 direction (sell): the method expects only a rejection from it.
M1 CF: a QM (BO Structure) buy, a candle closed above 1.35944. A buy limit rests at the barrier zone's near side 1.35964 for the pullback.

Price pulled back to the zone's near side: buy 1.35964, stop 1.35870 (0.00010 past the extreme 1.35880 made at the barrier, risk 0.00094), target 1.36058 (1R: the replay's own choice, the method names no fixed target here).
M15 barrier: a fresh supply zone 1.18146 to 1.18241, the origin of an internal BO sell.
Price came back to the barrier for the first time. Its confirmation is read on M1. The barrier is with the H1 direction (sell).
M1 CF: a QM (BO Structure) sell, a candle closed below 1.18121. A sell limit rests at that level for the pullback.

Price pulled back to the level: sell 1.18121, stop 1.18231 (0.00009 past the extreme 1.18222 made at the barrier, risk 0.00110), target 1.18011 (1R: the replay's own choice, the method names no fixed target here).
